div.style: color: rgb(17, 38, 56) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Versioned deterministic cash-flow engine
Deduplicate economic events and reconcile accounts
Calculate recurring receipts, costs and obligations
Build dated cash and repayment paths

div.style: color: rgb(17, 38, 56) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Current synthetic-case statistical service
Cash-mean credible interval
Future-cash predictive interval and shortfall probability

div.style: color: rgb(17, 38, 56) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Deterministic baseline alongside statistical evidence
Coverage, balance reconciliation and dated arrears
Case: trailing 30-day residual cash and cash floor
Extensions: approved rolling averages and seasonal checks
Record formula, window, cutoff and rule version

div.style: color: rgb(17, 38, 56) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:

Concentration and stress; verify numerical receipts
